issue.title: [PMON] | ERR pmon#xcvrd: Exception occured at SfpStateUpdateTask thread due to KeyError('status')

failure.body:
#### Description

The issue is probably introduced by commit: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/commit/56046dc36907c7e873911ef60e9193fe8717b12c. In this commit, it added several new fieds to TRANSECIVER_STATUS table. It casues a potential race condition:

- DomInfoUpdateTask would update TRANSECIVER_STATUS table by calling function `update_port_transceiver_status_table_hw`
- SfpStateUpdateTask would update TRANSECIVER_STATUS table by calling function `update_port_transceiver_status_table_sw`. It also  reads TRANSECIVER_STATUS table by line https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/blob/03374b24ac049f6476690208b482c72a35c974df/sonic-xcvrd/xcvrd/xcvrd.py#L2144 and access the table data by line https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/blob/03374b24ac049f6476690208b482c72a35c974df/sonic-xcvrd/xcvrd/xcvrd.py#L2155

So, there could be chance that, DomInfoUpdateTask has called update_port_transceiver_status_table_hw, but SfpStateUpdateTask  has not called update_port_transceiver_status_table_sw. In that case, 'status' would not exist in TRANSECIVER_STATUS table which causes a crash.

Not sure that updating the same table from different threads is a good idea, but as the change in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/commit/56046dc36907c7e873911ef60e9193fe8717b12c is big, I would recommend to fix the issue in `SfpStateUpdateTask::on_add_logical_port` if we don't want to revert that change.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
Use dynamic port breakout CLI to split port, there is a **small chance** to hit this issue.

#### Describe the results you received:

xcvrd crashed:
```
Mar  9 <IPV6>.894733 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: Exception occured at SfpStateUpdateTask thread due to KeyError('status')
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896630 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: Traceback (most recent call last):
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896630 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 2049, in run
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896720 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     self.task_worker(self.task_stopping_event, self.sfp_error_event)
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896732 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 1862, in task_worker
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896757 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     port_mapping.handle_port_config_change(sel, asic_context, stopping_event, self.port_mapping, helper_logger, self.on_port_config_change)
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896778 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd_utilities/port_mapping.py", line 225, in handle_port_config_change
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896799 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     read_port_config_change(asic_context, port_mapping, logger, port_change_event_handler)
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896820 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd_utilities/port_mapping.py", line 244, in read_port_config_change
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896837 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     port_change_event_handler(port_change_event)
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896869 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 2082, in on_port_config_change
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896869 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     self.on_add_logical_port(port_change_event)
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896869 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 2155, in on_add_logical_port
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896904 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     logical_port_event_dict[port_change_event.port_name] = dict(sfp_status)['status']
Mar  9 <IPV6>.896936 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: KeyError: 'status'
Mar  9 <IPV6>.897069 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: Xcvrd: exception found at child thread SfpStateUpdateTask due to KeyError('status')
Mar  9 <IPV6>.897069 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: Exiting main loop as child thread raised exception!
```

#### Describe the results you expected:

xcvrd should not crash

resolution.title: Fix issue: Exception occured at SfpStateUpdateTask thread due to KeyError('status')
resolution.description:
#### Description
Fix issue https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/14213.

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/commit/56046dc36907c7e873911ef60e9193fe8717b12c introduces a race condition between DomInfoUpdateTask and SfpStateUpdateTask. In this PR, `SfpStateUpdateTask::on_add_logical_port` is changed to no longer depending on TRANSECIVER_STATUS table and always get SFP data from platform API.

#### Motivation and Context
Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/14213
